1-3-24
Claim received for a rear-end collision involving the insured vehicle and a claimant who is represented by counsel.
Initial contact made with counsel's office to confirm representation and request the claimant's preliminary account of
the accident.
2-12-24
Reviewed the police report and statements from two independent witnesses, both of which confirm the accident
occurred as described and place the claimant inside the vehicle at the time. The other driver's account matches in all
material respects. The driver involved is named on the policy.
4-1-24
Photographs from the scene and the repair estimate were reviewed. The vehicle damage is consistent with the
described impact, and no prior damage to the vehicle is known from the records available. Nothing in the file suggests
the damage predates the policy's coverage period.
5-25-24
Counsel forwarded the claimant's medical records reporting a neck strain. The injury is a good match for the kind and
force of a collision of this type. No prior injury to the same body area is known from the claimant's history or the
records obtained so far.
5-30-24
The claimant's recorded statement was taken with conusel present. A few additional details were added compared
with the first account, but the core sequence of events remained the same. Treatment followed a typical course and
tapered off as the claimant's symptoms improved.
6-12-24
Reviewed the full treatment file and the updated statements. Findings are consistent across sources, and the claim is
progressing to evaluation on the documented facts. Next step is to confirm the final medical bills with counsel.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
